bus.name: AFI Data & Analytics
bus.bu_summary:
The AFI Data & Analytics business unit shows the clearest Daedalus convergence story in the portfolio. Across 20 projects and 1,171 scored items, the work splits roughly equally between KEEP (the working EDW data plane and EDME master-data fabric) and FOLD (BI cluster, ASCNO, DCC catalog work, and GSCA supply-chain analytics) — with most STOPs concentrated in the Discovery (GD) backlog where Phase 1 becomes the new enterprise idea funnel.

The strategic move is to keep the current EDW (BDE, CDA, DBA, EDA, DIS) running on a tight maintain track, convert the EDME family (DP, DW, EDME, DDF) into Phase 1 mapping artifacts as Units 01–03 cycle through, freeze net-new BI development across ARA, BW, BA, MM, and GSCA pending the AI4BI build, and absorb ASCNO and DCSH directly into Daedalus Innovation Engineering and Unit 03 substrate respectively. DCC's 187 catalog entries become the literal Phase 1 source register.

Two findings warrant immediate attention: EAS returned zero open items despite being the highest-priority semantic-layer duplication risk in the portfolio (likely off-Jira work), and DIS contains only sandbox/test data ("Test1", "sdfs", "trest") — the project needs to be cleared before real intake routes through it. GDKB's "OBSOLETE EDW Completion [AI]" epic carries a P0/starlight label and remains In Progress despite the title — confirm whether this should close before the Maintain-track posture takes effect.

cross_project_signals.title: EAS: highest-priority duplication risk, zero Jira evidence
cross_project_signals.body: Enterprise Analytics and Semantics (EAS) — flagged in the scrub instructions as the single most important semantic-layer duplication watch — returns zero open items on Jira. Either semantic-layer work happens entirely off-Jira (under another key, in Confluence, or as informal team activity), the project is a paper placeholder, or work has stalled. Treat as FLAG until confirmed; if real work is happening, redirect into Daedalus Platform pillar before parallel semantic infrastructure compounds.

cross_project_signals.title: EDW Completion epic still active despite OBSOLETE label
cross_project_signals.body: GDKB-46 'OBSOLETE EDW Completion [AI]' carries P0/starlight labels, sits In Progress, and was updated within the last week. The title declares the work obsolete but the workflow state contradicts that. The 'house on fire' framing in the description is exactly the kind of all-systems push that Daedalus Maintain-track is designed to retire. Close this epic explicitly or rename it — leaving it in the current state risks teams continuing to invest in completion work that the Daedalus plan has superseded.

cross_project_signals.title: DIS contains only sandbox / test data
cross_project_signals.body: Data Integration and Solutions (DIS) returns 11 open items with summaries like 'Test1', 'testsestss', 'sdfs', 'trest', '[O2D]-Story5', '[CX_P]-Test2'. Every description that exists is two or three characters. This is a clean project that someone seeded with template content; it has not yet been used for real work. Clear the sandbox tickets before real DIS intake begins, or downstream consumers will struggle to distinguish real epics from placeholder data.

cross_project_signals.title: Production support epics are the largest single in-flight commitment
cross_project_signals.body: Recurring sprint trackers (DW-360 [EO] Data Wave FY26-Production Support, DW-649 L4 WAVE, EDME-1187, DDF-139, DP-555, BA-129 Transactional Billing Issues) appear across every EDME and BI project. These are Gate 1 by definition and stay KEEP, but they signal that a significant share of the BU's bandwidth is consumed by run-the-business work — capacity that needs to be protected during the 45-day wave cycles, not raided for new mapping work.

cross_project_signals.title: EDME family is heavy on master-data — substrate-ready
cross_project_signals.body: DW (Enterprise Operations) and DDF (Plan & Make) carry the SiteMaster / RSM / store-hierarchy / postal-codes / UKG-ingestion workload. This is exactly the Layer 3 (master data) substrate the Planning Data Fabric will consume directly. Convert the active SiteMaster Sales Regions, Leadership Integration, and Real Estate Documentation epics into Phase 1 artifacts for Unit 01 (Supply Chain) rather than treating them as independent EDME deliverables.

cross_project_signals.title: BI cluster has heavy stale carry — natural Gate 5 candidates
cross_project_signals.body: BI ADS (BA) has multiple epics last updated December 2025 or earlier (BA-90 Amanda's Work Items, BA-81 Firm Plus Plan EDW move, BA-43 LMS 2.0, BA-18 Firm Plus Plan logic, BA-267 Per Diem Changes). These were marked STOP under the 180-day stale rule. The pattern suggests BI ADS is carrying a several-year accumulation of half-started work; AI4BI replacement is the right exit path, but the cleanup should start by closing items that the team has already de facto abandoned.

cross_project_signals.title: DCSH is a fresh infra build — absorb before sunk cost grows
cross_project_signals.body: Data Customer Service Hub (DCSH) is 6 items, all dated April 22 2026, all 'Setup Infrastructure for Customer Support Hub — Setup Databricks Workspace / Setup Unity Catalog / Setup Python Development Environment / Analyze LivePerson / Analyze TalkDesk'. The team is building net-new Databricks + Unity Catalog infrastructure for a Customer Service data product. Unit 03 (Customer Care) kicks off after Units 01–02, and the Daedalus substrate will provide this exact capability. Redirect the DCSH team to Unit 03 substrate work before more sunk cost accumulates.

cross_project_signals.title: ASCNO is the textbook FOLD case
cross_project_signals.body: AI - Supply Chain Network Optimization (60 items) is building AI/ML for Supply Chain optimization in parallel with Daedalus Unit 01 (Supply Chain Planning), which kicked off May 18. Every item — forecast, optimization, allocation, consolidation, inventory — maps directly to capabilities the Daedalus Innovation Engineering pillar will deliver. Repoint the team into Unit 01 substrate; harvest the existing models as candidate reusable agent services.

cross_project_signals.title: DCC catalog is the literal Phase 1 source register
cross_project_signals.body: DP: Catalog of catalogs (DCC) has 187 open tasks, each tracking a single source-system catalog. This is exactly the inventory artifact Phase 1 produces — the deliverable already exists as a project, just labeled differently. Migrate the content into the Daedalus Phase 1 source register; sunset DCC as a standalone catalog effort once content is transferred.

cross_project_signals.title: Discovery (GD) competes directly with Phase 1 intake
cross_project_signals.body: Global Data (GD) is a Jira Product Discovery board with 97 open ideas. Roughly half map to wave-unit domains (Supply Chain, Finance, Customer Care, supplier/vendor master data) and convert to Phase 1 inputs. The other half are generic improvement ideas not tied to a wave unit; Phase 1 becomes the new enterprise idea funnel and these collapse. Continuing GD as an independent intake risks two parallel idea pipelines.

open_questions.q: Does EAS (Enterprise Analytics and Semantics) work happen entirely off-Jira, or under a different project key? The single highest-priority duplication risk in the portfolio has zero Jira evidence — we need to confirm whether the team exists, what they're building, and whether it should converge with the Daedalus Platform pillar.
open_questions.unlocks: Whether semantic-layer duplication is a real risk or a paper concern

open_questions.q: Should GDKB-46 'OBSOLETE EDW Completion [AI]' close explicitly? It carries P0/starlight labels and remains In Progress despite the OBSOLETE prefix in the title. Leaving it ambiguous risks teams continuing to invest in completion work that the Daedalus Maintain-track has superseded.
open_questions.unlocks: Clear Maintain-track posture for the current EDW

open_questions.q: Is DIS (Data Integration and Solutions) ready for real intake, or should the sandbox/template content be cleared first? All 11 open items are test data ('Test1', 'sdfs', 'trest'). The project needs a defined first real epic before downstream consumers can use it as a routing target.
open_questions.unlocks: Whether DIS is a usable intake channel or needs reset

open_questions.q: Is the BDE (~106 of 150+ items) and DBA (~162 of 250+ items) sampling boundary appropriate, or should the full backlogs be re-pulled for completeness? Sampling captured the most recent six months; older items may need a separate Gate-5 sweep.
open_questions.unlocks: Confidence in the EDW core verdict distribution

open_questions.q: Who owns the conversion of EDME master-data work (SiteMaster, RSM, store hierarchy, postal codes) into Phase 1 artifacts for Unit 01? The current EDME team holds the domain knowledge but is structured as a Maintain organization. Either retain EDME and convert artifacts in-place, or stand up a Phase 1 squad with EDME representation.
open_questions.unlocks: Phase 1 conversion ownership and capacity plan for Unit 01

open_questions.q: Should DCSH (Customer Service Hub data infra build) pause its Databricks/Unity Catalog setup pending Unit 03 substrate decisions? The 6 tickets are dev-environment setup work that will likely be redone on the Daedalus substrate. Cheaper to wait than to migrate.
open_questions.unlocks: Avoidance of duplicated infrastructure spend for Unit 03

open_questions.q: Is the GD Discovery board the planned sunset target once Phase 1 becomes the enterprise idea funnel, or does GD continue alongside Phase 1 for non-wave ideas? The scrub default is collapse, but explicit confirmation will avoid teams continuing to file ideas in both places.
open_questions.unlocks: Single intake funnel vs parallel discovery channels
